edges.reason: isAuthorized reads the stored authority contract address to delegate permission checks
msg.sender is passed as src into isAuthorized, controlling who passes the auth modifier
auth modifier evaluates msg.sender/msg.sig before setOwner writes the owner state variable
setOwner writes the untrusted owner_ parameter into owner after the auth check
auth modifier gates setAuthority before authority is overwritten
setAuthority overwrites the authority state variable used by isAuthorized
owner_ parameter flows into owner storage assignment in setOwner
tx.origin is used to query BotRegistry and select the lower AUTOMATIC_SERVICE_FEE tier, allowing origin spoofing
_amount parameter is divided by fee to derive the fee amount
_user parameter drives Discount.isCustomFeeSet/getCustomServiceFee fee override
feeAmount local is accumulated by division and gas-cost addition inside getFee
computed feeAmount is transferred out to WALLET_ADDR for ETH or ERC20
_gasCost parameter is scaled by oracle price inside getGasCost
gasCost result is transferred to WALLET_ADDR
changeMonitor stores block.timestamp into changeRequestedTimestamp, timestamp dependency
confirmNewMonitor compares block.timestamp against the requested timestamp plus CHANGE_PERIOD
onlyMonitor modifier compares msg.sender against the stored monitor address before execute
callExecute performs an external DSProxy execute with msg.value before returning leftover ETH, exposing reentrancy
returnEth sends the full contract balance back to msg.sender via transfer after external interactions
migrate/unsubscribe flows perform external subscription calls and guard creation that can re-enter
createProxyAndCDP builds the proxy for msg.sender and transfers CDP ownership back
withdrawStuckFunds is onlyOwner and transfers the whole stuck balance to owner
withdrawStuckFunds performs payable(owner).transfer or safeTransfer for the rescue
kill is onlyOwner and executes selfdestruct(payable(owner))
sendContractBalance performs payable(_user).transfer or ERC20 safeTransfer to an arbitrary address
sendFullContractBalance delegates to sendContractBalance with the full balance
getMaxCollateral and getMaxBorrow share fixed point fee/math helpers and oracle derived amounts
user-supplied address parameter feeds Aave collateral computations keyed to an arbitrary account
getGasCost and getFee share the same fee cap accounting pattern in Aave/Compound helpers

normalization_plan.reason: The _user parameter only exists to be consumed by getFee for discount lookup, so it should be folded into that core function node
The _amount parameter is only used inside getFee to derive the fee, so it should be merged into the getFee function node
feeAmount is a local accumulator that is returned and transferred by getFee, so it collapses into the enclosing core function
The _gasCost parameter is exclusively processed by getGasCost, so it should be merged into that core function node
The owner_ parameter is only assigned to owner inside setOwner, so it should be folded into the setOwner function node
